seo.metaTitle: Password & passphrase generator — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Generate high-entropy random passwords or memorable multi-word XKCD passphrases using your browser’s cryptographic random source. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/crypto/password-gen-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: Password & passphrase generator processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/crypto/password-gen-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does Password & passphrase generator upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. Password & passphrase generator executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/crypto/password-gen-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate Password & passphrase generator?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/password_gen.json or open /tools/password-gen?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
